data.name: MWE5_001
data.value: Finally![pause=0] We're out of {0}!

data.name: MWE5_002
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] it's already dark![pause=0] I hope we're not too late...

data.name: MWE5_003
data.value: We should set up camp here and rest before the final climb.

data.name: MWE5_004
data.value: Tomorrow, we'll reach Cloven Ruins...[pause=0] assuming the mountain lets us pass.

data.name: MWE5_005
data.value: Alright.[pause=0] Let's rest up and regain our strength.

data.name: MWE5_006
data.value: The summit is closer than it looks, but the wind will not make it easy.

data.name: MWE5_007
data.value: We should stay together. The mountain has already separated us once.

data.name: MWE5_008
data.value: The weather changed before sunset. That is not normal for this route.

data.name: MWE5_009
data.value: If the wind rises again, we stop. No one is proving anything by collapsing.

data.name: MWE5_010
data.value: We crossed the tunnel. We can cross a mountain too.

data.name: MWE5_011
data.value: And if the path changes, we will read it together and find another way.

data.name: MWE5_012
data.value: That is the spirit! We made it this far because nobody stayed behind.

data.name: MWE5_013
data.value: Do not mistake enthusiasm for preparation. Check your supplies before sleeping.

data.name: MWE5_014
data.value: I already checked them twice. I can check them a third time!

data.name: MWE5_015
data.value: Please do. The summit is no place for a careless mistake.

data.name: MWE5_016
data.value: We will be careful. Tomorrow we finish this climb as a team.

data.name: MWE5_017
data.value: The wind is carrying a strange sound from above us.

data.name: MWE5_018
data.value: It may be the ruins. Or the mountain may be warning us away.

data.name: MWE5_019
data.value: Then we listen, remember what we heard, and keep our eyes open.

data.name: MWE5_020
data.value: Tomorrow, we reach the summit.
